operations.name: Create knowledge context
operations.description: Create a new knowledge entry in your organization. Send as `multipart/form-data`. The `file` field is optional — omit it to create an entry without an attachment.

title.description: Title of the knowledge entry. Must be unique in your organization.

content.description: Body text (markdown supported). Omit when providing a file attachment instead.

product_scopes.description: Products that can consume this entry.

operations.name: Create skill
operations.description: Create a skill in your organization from its files. `SKILL.md` carries its instructions and is required; `custom-instructions.md` and any other path, such as `references/setup.md`, are optional. The title is stored as a slug and must not match another skill in your organization or a Lumos-provided one: a clash returns 409 `skill.already_exists`. The response is the skill as `GET /v1/knowledge/skil

title.description: Title for the skill, unique in your organization. It is stored as a slug, so `Vendor Onboarding` becomes `vendor-onboarding`; the response carries the stored title.

files.description: The skill's files. Exactly one must be `SKILL.md`, which may open with YAML frontmatter whose `description` becomes the skill's summary. Paths must be unique.

operations.name: Delete knowledge context
operations.description: Delete a knowledge entry. It no longer appears in list results, and you can't restore it through the API.

knowledge_context_id.description: The knowledge entry's ID, which `GET /v1/knowledge/context` returns as `id`.

operations.name: Get knowledge context
operations.description: Get one knowledge entry by ID, with its content, tags, product scopes, and the URL of any attached file. A deleted entry, or an ID that matches no entry in your organization, returns 404 `knowledge.not_found`.

knowledge_context_id.description: The knowledge entry's ID, which `GET /v1/knowledge/context` returns as `id`.

operations.name: Get skill
operations.description: Get one skill by title, with every file it carries. A disabled skill is still returned, with `is_enabled` false. A title that matches no skill in your organization returns 404 `skill.not_found`.

operations.name: List knowledge context
operations.description: List knowledge entries in your organization with optional filters and cursor pagination. Pass the `next_page_token` value from the previous response back as the `page_token` query parameter to fetch the next page. When `next_page_token` is `null`, the current page is the last one.

title_search.description: Case-insensitive substring match against knowledge entry titles.

product_scopes.description: Filter to entries tagged with any of these product scopes.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 25 are clamped to 25 rather than rejected.

operations.name: List skills
operations.description: List the skills available to your organization, including Lumos-provided defaults, with each skill's files unless `include_files=false`. filters.description: JSON array of `{field, operator, values}` predicates, AND'ed together. Fields: `title`, `is_enabled`, `is_default`.

enabled_state.description: Shorthand for an `is_enabled` filter. `any` (the default) adds none.

include_files.description: Return each skill's files. Send `false` for titles and summaries only.

page_token.description: Opaque cursor from a previous response's `next_page_token`. Omit to fetch the first page. Treat as opaque: do not decode, construct, or interpret it.

page_size.description: Maximum number of items to return per page. Values above 25 are clamped to 25 rather than rejected.

operations.name: Put skill file
operations.description: Write one file of a skill, creating it or replacing its content. `SKILL.md` replaces the instructions; a frontmatter `name` in it renames the skill, so read `title` from the response. A `name` that matches another skill in your organization or a Lumos-provided one returns 409 `skill.already_exists`. `custom-instructions.md` replaces your organization's additions. skill_id.description: The skill's `id`, which every skill read and write returns.

path.description: Path of the file within the skill, e.g. `references/setup.md`.

content.description: Full text of the file; replaces any existing file at this path. For `SKILL.md`, a frontmatter `name` renames the skill and `description` replaces its summary.

operations.name: Update knowledge context
operations.description: Patch an existing knowledge entry. Only supplied (non-empty) fields are updated. Tag and scope lists replace existing values entirely — they do not append. Send as `multipart/form-data`. To replace the attached file, include a `file` field. To remove the existing file without uploading a new one, set `clear_attachment=true`.

knowledge_context_id.description: The knowledge entry's ID, which `GET /v1/knowledge/context` returns as `id`.

title.description: New title. Omit to leave unchanged.

content.description: New content body. Omit to leave unchanged.

generic_tags.description: Replacement tag list — replaces all existing tags. Omit to leave unchanged.

product_scopes.description: Replacement product scope list — replaces all existing scopes. Omit to leave unchanged.

clear_attachment.description: When true, removes the existing file attachment without uploading a new one.

file.description: Replacement file attachment. Omit to leave existing file unchanged.
